Find the prototype.
Interrupt! Interrupt them at all costs! Interrupt the enemies before they destroy you with their attack! Give this a try, okay?

Enemy shields and Aggeloi carapaces can effectively block frontal attacks. 
Stay on your feet, attack quickly, and knock them back.

Become the archipelagic storm and strike with the speed and ferocity of a tempest! 
Throw the enemies off their feet. Stagger them then lift them to the skies! Keep them helpless!

Strike with the fearsome weight of Blight Zone boulders! 
Throw the enemies off their feet! Stagger them then knock them to the ground! Keep them helpless!

Originium Arts have been employed in every form of weaponry and equipment: blades, swords, handcannons, Arts units, and armor suits. 
Wield the power of Arts Inflictions and Arts Bursts.
Heat is a cheap and effective form of energy. Inflict heat upon your enemies and set them off in spectacular combustion.
Freeze their minds and lock their physical forms in place. Use cryogenic forces to solidify your enemies.
Let the electrons course through their veins. See if you can electrify the enemies.
Think of a way to corrode their defenses so that their armor sloughs off like leaves off a cob of corn. Inflict Corrode upon your foes.
Good. The more the merrier. Interrupt the enemies and their attacks! Don't leave any attack uninterrupted!

Wonderful. Time for the first part of our final test. 
It's simple. Win without getting hurt and you'll pass.

This is the final part of our final test! Someone asked for a big brawl. 
Don't get hurt, Endmin! Show me the powers you've recovered!
Use the Packaging Unit to set up an automatic LC Battery production line and charge the combat facilities.
Use the Packaging Unit to set up an automatic SC Battery production line.
Produce Industrial Explosives, then use them to blast apart the rubble and rescue the trapped victims.
The Relay Tower is down. Use the right facilities to produce materials for repairing it.

A batch of materials must be delivered to AIC facilities for processing and the products must be sent back to the Depot. Connect the current facility layout with transport belts to create a logistics line.
Use the bus, transport belts, and other logistic facilities to set up a complex production line.
The AIC Factory can now utilize the Bus, a flexible and effective logistics facility.
Use the bus and transport belts to set up a complex production line.
The Zipline Tower is broken. Use the Fitting Unit to produce Amethyst Parts for repairing the facility.
The AIC Factory can now utilize the Belt Bridge that lets a transport belt span another.
The AIC Factory can now utilize the Converger that converges product flows of multiple transport belts into a single belt.
Use the Filling Unit to set up auto-production lines for food and medicine.
Use the AIC Factory to process Ferrium Ore. Use Ferrium Bottles to produce improved canned citromes.
Upgrade the medicine production line with the Grinding Unit to produce the improved medicine: Buck Capsule [A].
Use pipes and Filling Unit Fluid Mode to transport fluids into the facility to produce Jinlong food and medicine.
Jinlong Integrated Applications
You must powder a batch of materials and transport the products back to the Depot. Connect the current facilities with transport belts to create a production line.
Use the AIC Factory to create an automated Buckflower Powder production line.
Sewage is a polluting byproduct of facilities running in fluid mode. Use a Water Treatment Unit to clean it up.
Use the Electric Mining Rig to mine Amethyst Ore and replace existing Portable Originium Rigs to achieve auto-mining and belt-free transfer of Originium Ore.
Use Electric Mining Rigs Mk II to mine every mining spot of the area.
Hydro Mining Rigs do not need power but water to start mining. Mine some Cuprium Ore with Hydro Mining Rigs.
Reactor Crucibles can react solid material with fluids to create solutions. Add powdered plants and Clean Water into the Reactor Crucible to produce plant solutions.
Expand the Reactor Crucible cache to produce different solutions simultaneously. Improve the current production line to reduce the number of Reactor Crucibles needed.
Use pipes, Fluid Pumps, and Fluid Supply Units to transport various fluids.
Use pipe logistics units to create a working pipeline and complete the complex production network.
Use the Planting Unit and Seed-Picking Unit to create a self-sufficient plant production loop.
Planting Unit can use Fluid Mode to grow Jinlong plants. You have limited Fluid Pumps. Use Pipe Splitters to supply Clean Water to multiple facilities.
Use Relay Towers and Electric Pylons to complete the power grid.
Use Thermal Banks to raise the power grid output and restore operations to the AIC facilities.
Use the AIC Factory to create an automated Amethyst Bottle production line to supply containers for making Buck Capsules [C].
The Fluid Mode of the Moulding Unit can produce higher quality containers to supply quality food and medicine production.
The number of production lines is limited by the number of output ports. The AIC Factory now has the Splitter to split a single output belt into 3.
Use pipes, Fluid Pumps, and Sprinklers to auto-irrigate the plots.
You must move a batch of Originium Ore to the Depot. Complete the power grid and use the belt-free transfer of the Protocol Stash to transport the ore back to the depot.
The AIC Factory can now utilize the Grinding Unit that uses Sandleaf Powder to grind materials into ultra-fine compressible particles for making higher quality medicine and gear.
Use the Gearing Unit to produce Amethyst Components.
Jinlong Trials
